title: Onyix Claims
description: Onyix Claims is a lightweight grief protection plugin for Minecraft servers. Players use a Golden Shovel to claim land, trust friends, and keep their builds safe. Fully configurable for any server size.
body:
Onyix Claims

The lightweight, no-nonsense grief protection plugin your server actually needs.
OnyixClaims gives your players a simple, intuitive way to protect their builds — no bloat, no confusion. Grab a golden shovel, select your corners, and your land is yours.

🛡️ Core Protection
Every claim is a fortress. Untrusted players are blocked from:

Breaking or placing blocks inside your claim
Opening containers chests, barrels, shulker boxes, and more
Flicking levers, opening doors, or using any interactive blocks
Harming friendly mobs, armor stands, and item frames
Overlapping your land every claim has one clear owner


🛠️ How It Works

Hold a Golden Shovel
Left click one corner of your land
Right click the opposite corner
Run /claim create — done. Your land is protected.

It's that simple. No GUIs to figure out, no steep learning curve.

👥 Trust System
Want to build with friends? Use /claim trust <player> to grant full build and interact permissions inside your claim. Change your mind? /claim untrust <player> removes them instantly.

⚙️ Fully Configurable
Server owners stay in full control:

Set a maximum claim size (e.g. 500x500)
Limit how many claims each player can own
Customize every message with colour codes (&) and placeholders like {limit}


🔑 Admin Tools
Staff with the onyix.claims.admin permission can view, manage, or delete any claim on the server — keeping your community safe and disputes resolved fast.

📋 Commands

/claim help        - Shows the help menu
/claim create      - Creates a claim from your Golden Shovel selection
/claim delete      - Deletes the claim you are standing in (must be owner)
/claim trust       - Grants a player build and interact permissions in your claim
/claim untrust     - Revokes permissions from a trusted player

💡 Why Onyix Claims?

✅ Lightweight — minimal server impact
✅ Intuitive golden shovel selection
✅ Clean, fully configurable config.yml
✅ Active development & fast version updates
✅ Perfect for survival, SMP, and semi-vanilla servers
